reason: no_reward. SquadSwap WOW is a PancakeSwap/Uniswap V3 fork ('Changeable V3', adjustable fee tiers via an owner-gated PoolManager). Factory, pool, PoolManager and position-manager ABIs expose only standard V3 user actions: swap/mint/burn/collect pay the LP or the NFT owner, collectProtocol pays the factory owner; no function pays a stranger for calling. LP fee revenue exists but goes to capital providers, not to callers.
